description: Futures state-vector rows — ~130 derived columns per contract-day: forward-return labels (y_cc/y_settle/y_oc), roll-boundary flags, session mechanics, Kyle lambda variants, ADV share, macro/yield context. Free with X-ORKID-API-Key or $0.05 USDC/call via x402.
